channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: South Korean President Lee pushes back on Alaska LNG project after Trump touts Seoul's participation
item.description: The U.S. announced plans for up to $200 billion in South Korean investment, though Seoul has yet to finalize the participation in the Alaska LNG project.

item.title: Passengers and crew foil co-pilot's apparent attempt to crash FlyDubai flight to Israel
item.description: One of the pilots on a FlyDubai flight headed for Israel stabbed the second pilot, according to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

item.title: Stock futures rise as traders eye elevated Treasury yields, brace for jobs report due this week: Live updates
item.description: Investors are weighing a softer inflation picture, higher Treasury yields and uncertainty over the Fed's next rate decision.

item.title: Trump 'thinking about' diesel export ban, but says it could have 'negative impact' on gasoline
item.description: Trump recently said he was "very seriously" considering a diesel export ban, despite warnings from the U.S. oil industry that doing so would raise prices.

item.title: AI race heats up as OpenAI flags alleged model-copying campaign
item.description: OpenAI says it identified an attempt to extract protected reasoning from its AI models, linking part of the activity with China’s Moonshot AI.

item.title: Portfolio adviser to the super-rich wanted a bigger stock market correction. Here's why
item.description: Citi Wealth would have welcomed a deeper stock-market correction this year, seeing any bigger pullback as an opportunity to buy.

item.title: UK Prime Minister Burnham says Iran 'played a part' in British air base incident
item.description: RAF Fairford has been used as the U.S. Air Force's command outpost for operations from Europe and for American strikes on Iranian missile sites.

item.title: Micron beats on earnings and issues strong guidance as data center revenue jumps 11-fold
item.description: Micron is up over 500% in the past year as the company benefits from soaring AI demand.

item.title: Sen. Hawley: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman declined to testify at rogue AI hearing
item.description: A Senate subcommittee on Wednesday is examining rogue AI, after a series of AI cyberattacks and increasing warnings about the risks of the technology.

item.title: Trump’s AI lunch included every major tech company. Except Apple
item.description: Apple's absence from Trump's AI lunch raised eyebrows, but the company is known to look out for its own interests.

item.title: In photos: China's Xi hardens Taiwan warning as country celebrates week-long National Day holiday
item.description: China began its seven-day National Day holiday on Thursday after President Xi Jinping used his annual speech to sharpen Beijing's message on Taiwan.

item.title: Trump administration starts sending $500 Obamacare refund checks — who stands to benefit
item.description: The refunds come after millions of people lost premium subsidies for their health insurance and right before the midterm elections.

item.title: Broken market: 75% of S&P 500 stocks had a lousy September
item.description: The S&P 500 appears strong at the index level, but most of its individual stocks had a poor month.

item.title: Thursday's big stock stories: What’s likely to move the market in the next trading session
item.description: The S&P 500 fell on Wednesday as traders looked past a softer-than-anticipated inflation report. The broad index posted a loss for the month of September.

item.title: Cramer says 'frozen' conditions are holding many stocks back. Here's what could change that
item.description: CNBC's Jim Cramer said Wednesday that several key parts of the U.S. economy have effectively frozen.

item.title: This driverless trucking stock could be a double or more. Here’s why I’m buying despite the risks
item.description: Aurora Innovation is scaling its driverless trucking business rapidly, while a shift to an asset-light model could accelerate growth.

item.title: David Ellison names Ynon Kreiz co-CEO of Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery
item.description: Paramount CEO David Ellison announced outgoing Mattel chief Ynon Kreiz will serve as the co-CEO of the anticipated combination of Paramount and WBD.

item.title: California Gov. Gavin Newsom bans AI 'robo bosses' in landmark state law, reversing his earlier veto
item.description: California Governor Gavin Newsom has banned 'robo-bosses' from firing workers, the first U.S. state with such a law.

item.title: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Argon, its most advanced AI model
item.description: Gemini 4 Argon is Alphabet's most advanced model yet, with major coding, cybersecurity, and complex professional work improvements.

item.title: Meta stock enjoys best month since 2022 on AI momentum
item.description: Meta stock had its best month in almost four years as investors cheer the social media giant's recent momentum in artificial intelligence.

item.title: Why Jim Cramer isn't buying more Boeing despite its huge Navy contract win
item.description: Two main issues are holding him up.

item.title: Gen Z’s 'little treat’ economy is thriving. These financial products help you enjoy responsibly
item.description: Gen Z is spending on small indulgences even as finances stay tight. Here are four ways to budget for little treats more intentionally.

item.title: Inside India newsletter: Foreign insurers get the red-carpet treatment — and policy uncertainty
item.description: Foreign insurers brace for another set of policy changes in India's insurance market.

item.title: Inside Man: How Chinese spies used lies, love and betrayal to target the Federal Reserve
item.description: A CNBC investigation shows how former Fed advisor John Rogers became entangled with a man U.S. officials identify as a Chinese intelligence operative.

item.title: Treasury launches student loan support center as new data show 9.3 million borrowers in default
item.description: The Trump administration announced on Wednesday that it was launching a "Default Loans Support Center" for student loan borrowers who've fallen behind.

item.title: Fed's Kashkari says inflation is 'still too high' even after softer-than-expected PCE data, labor market is 'pretty good'
item.description: Kashkari sat down with CNBC's Steve Liesman for an exclusive conversation Wednesday night.

item.title: Grindr expands beyond dating with $250 million telehealth acquisition of PurposeMed
item.description: Grindr is buying PrEP provider Freddie for $250 million, expanding into healthcare and seeking to make HIV prevention more accessible to its users.

item.title: Fed watchdog finds renovation failures, but no grounds for criminal referral
item.description: The long-awaited report by the Fed's inspector general said it found no reasonable grounds to believe federal criminal law had been violated.

item.title: Elon Musk, Palmer Luckey and Newt Gingrich to help Pentagon with warfare initiative, Hegseth says
item.description: Pete Hegseth, in remarks about the state of the military, announced a project led by two GOP-supporting tech executives to examine military capabilities.

item.title: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick reports more than $250 million in income last year
item.description: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick unwound his ties to Cantor Fitzgerald as the billionaire financier joined the Trump administration.
